title: Tidy the branch
brief:
`feature` works, but its story is a mess: "add parser", "WIP", "debug junk", "add tests". Before this branch merges, the story should be: parser (complete), tests. The WIP commit's changes belong INSIDE the parser commit; the debug commit should not exist at all.

`git rebase -i main` opens the rebase worksheet: one line per commit, oldest first, each starting with a verb. It appears in your editor as `REBASE_TODO`. Change the verbs: keep the parser commit with `pick`, fold WIP into it with `squash`, drop the junk with `drop`, keep the tests. Save, then run `git rebase --continue`.

This is the real interactive rebase, minus the terminal editor: the todo list is the whole interface.

goals.label: WIP is squashed into the parser commit
The WIP lines survived the squash

hints: git rebase -i main writes REBASE_TODO into your file list. Open it in the editor.
Line order is oldest first. Make line 2 read 'squash <sha> WIP' and line 3 read 'drop <sha> debug junk'. Save, then git rebase --continue.
Deleting a line also drops the commit. The sha in each line must match the worksheet; only the verb changes.
